items.title: The graduate premium can no longer be taken for granted.
items.statement: A degree is no longer a guaranteed route to economic security. Students, particularly international students making a substantial investment, need stronger evidence that their King's education will expand what they can know, do and contribute.

items.title: Lead with an integrated model of graduate value.
items.statement: King's will connect disciplinary education, purposeful experience, student agency and credible evidence into a distinctive institutional model, rather than reducing employability to standalone services or internship volume.
See relevant opportunities, make purposeful choices and leave with credible evidence of what they know, can do and contribute.
Receive course-level insight, shared infrastructure and targeted support to strengthen and articulate distinctive provision.
Identify where graduate value is strong or uneven, direct investment accordingly and make stronger institutional claims.

proofPoints.title: What progress will look like
proofPoints.intro: The theory becomes credible through visible changes in practice, capability and evidence.
items: Course teams use graduate futures evidence to make credible claims and agree proportionate enhancements.
More students access high-quality experiential learning through curriculum and the wider King's experience.
Every student is invited into a continuing conversation about purpose, direction and development.
A shared skills language connects courses, opportunities and future possibilities.
A fuller record of learning connects academic achievement, recognised experience and student evidence.
Participation and outcomes evidence shows who is benefiting and directs support and investment.

deliveryPrinciple.title: Built progressively, reused institutionally
deliveryPrinciple.summary: Shared capabilities will be sequenced around demonstrable value, developed once where possible and reused across courses and services.
deliveryPrinciple.detail: The model does not depend on every element arriving at once. Early deliverables test the mechanisms while building reusable evidence, data, digital, opportunity and recognition capabilities. Benefits, ownership and recurrent operating costs must be explicit before wider scale.

scopeTest.title: What belongs in King's Edge?
scopeTest.summary: Work belongs when it materially strengthens one or more mechanisms and can show how that contribution will be tested.
criteria: Strengthens the underlying student experience or its equitable reach.
Helps students understand and connect the value of their learning and experiences.
Enables purposeful choices, relevant navigation or meaningful participation.
Creates trusted recognition or evidence that improves the system.
scopeTest.exclusion: Activity that cannot demonstrate a credible contribution to the mechanisms, outcomes or learning loop should remain outside the programme, be redesigned or stop.
